tldr: Uranus in the 2nd house: freedom becomes personal through money, values, security, self-worth, and what helps life feel steady.
body:
With Uranus in the 2nd house, this part of you awakens through money, values, security, self-worth, and what helps life feel steady. Uranus describes freedom, disruption, originality, change, and the need to break from stale patterns. In practice, this brings attention to what you earn, keep, choose, spend, protect, and come to understand as worth your energy.

When this placement is supported, you can build a steadier relationship with what supports you. Uranus can become honesty, invention, independence, and the courage to change what has become too small.

When it is strained, comfort, spending, fear, or self-protection can start making choices for you. The harder pattern can show up as instability, detachment, rebellion for its own sake, or changing everything to escape one pressure point.
gift: honesty, invention, independence, and the courage to change what has become too small expressed through money, values, security, self-worth, and what helps life feel steady.
challenge: instability, detachment, rebellion for its own sake, or changing everything to escape one pressure point around money, values, security, self-worth, and what helps life feel steady.
